description: The national mining cadastre of Brazil as open geodata. The dataset page on the Brazilian open data portal says SIGMINE holds the polygons of mining processes that are active and inactive, leases, blocked areas, water source protection areas and artisanal mining reserves, as zipped shapefile and zipped KML, with KML only for active processes, and that the data are generated daily. It gives the licence as Creative Commons Attribution, formats KMZ, ODS and ZIP, daily updates, the last file change on 25 September 2026 and more than 57,000 downloads, with the ANM geospatial data coordination as the responsible team. It is free to download. Coverage is Brazil. Caveats: the portal flags the dataset as outdated in its metadata rating, and attribute definitions are not stated on the page read. For simulation it maps mining titles and their owners and phases, to locate mines and linked assets such as tailings dams and to screen them against hazards. A related catalogue record is the ANM SIGBM mining dams register.
